items.title: EU forces board suspected Russian shadow fleet tanker in Mediterranean, Kallas says
items.teaser: "The EU will keep disrupting Russia's shadow fleet at sea and through diplomatic means," Kaja Kallas said.

items.title: Married couple who went a year without bread in Oleshky embrace two-year-old grandson after rescue
items.teaser: Nina and Anatolii escaped occupied Kherson Oblast and held their grandson for the first time. They had survived on goosefoot pancakes and rationed vegetables amid exorbitant food prices.

items.title: Zelenskyy: Starshield restrictions prevent Ukrainian drones from catching up with jet-powered Shaheds
items.teaser: President Volodymyr Zelenskyy has said Starshield terminals cut off interceptor drones at 161 km/h, so many Russian jet-powered Shaheds hit substations.

items.title: Ukrzaliznytsia not expecting freight traffic to increase in 2027
items.teaser: JSC Ukrzaliznytsia does not expect freight transportation to increase next year due to the blockade of seaports.

items.title: Russen verletzen in Region Donezk vier Zivilisten
items.teaser: Infolge des Beschusses der russischen Angreifer wurden vier Menschen am 14. November in der Region Donezk verletzt.

items.title: Islamisten als Wolf im Schafspelz? Bremen stoppt Kampagne
items.teaser: Der Bremer Verfassungsschutz will vor Islamisten warnen, die ohne Gewalt agieren. Die Art und Weise kommt nicht überall gut an.

items.title: Invaders hit company in Chuhuiv with drone, fire breaks out
items.teaser: A fire broke out at a company in Chuhuiv, Kharkiv region, after it was hit by a Russian drone.

items.title: Warehouses catch fire in Vyshhorod district following enemy attack
items.teaser: A fire broke out at a company’s warehouse facilities in the Vyshhorod district of the Kyiv region following a Russian attack on Sunday morning.

items.title: Ukraine strikes two petrochemical plants in Tatarstan and Russian helicopter manufacturing facility
items.teaser: Ukraine's General Staff says Ukrainian forces struck Nizhnekamskneftekhim, the Nizhnekamsk refinery's only primary distillation unit and the Monolit helicopter parts plant in Bryansk Oblast.

items.teaser: Wladimir Putin persönlich unterstützt einen Waffenstillstand nicht.

items.title: Two injured in Russian drone strike on Bilozerka
items.teaser: Russian invaders attacked the village of Bilozerka in the Kherson region with a drone on Sunday morning, injuring two people.

items.title: Enemy drone attacks damage property in five districts of Kyiv region, one person injured
items.teaser: Damage from Russian drone attacks over the past 24 hours has been reported in five districts of the Kyiv region.

items.title: Ukraine strikes Russian military airfield in Astrakhan Oblast, drone launch site in Oryol Oblast, General Staff says
items.teaser: In Astrakhan Oblast, drones targeted the Akhtubinsk airfield, which hosts Russia's 929th State Flight Test Center, one of the country's main facilities for testing new military aircraft and weapons.

items.title: Russian drone strikes bus in Kharkiv
items.teaser: A Russian attack drone has struck the roof of a bus in the Kyivskyi district of Kharkiv.

items.title: Russia launches 'mass attack' on Odesa Oblast as strikes kill 4, injure 69 across Ukraine over past day

items.title: She was the first woman in Sheikh Mansur Battalion: Ukrainian drone operator Raiana killed in action
items.teaser: Raiana, a drone operator from the Sheikh Mansur Chechen Volunteer Battalion, has been killed in action.

items.title: Russian drone strikes residential building in Kropyvnytskyi, three injured
items.teaser: A Russian drone has struck a residential building in Kropyvnytskyi.

items.title: Ukrainian foreign minister reminds Putin of limits of negotiations
items.teaser: Ukraine's Foreign Minister Andrii Sybiha has said Russia cannot redraw Europe's security order after nearly five years of war, and the most it can negotiate is a ceasefire

items.title: Generalstab meldet binnen eines Tages 171 Gefechte an der Front, die heftigsten Kämpfe dauern im Raum Pokrowsk an
items.teaser: Am 14. November kam es zu 171 Gefechten zwischen den ukrainischen Verteidigern und den russischen Angreifern an der Front.

items.title: Russian attack on Chornomorsk leaves six injured, damages energy infrastructure
items.teaser: Six people were injured in a Russian attack on the city of Chornomorsk in the Odesa region. Energy infrastructure and an administrative building were also damaged.

items.title: Russian forces strike energy infrastructure in Zhytomyr region
items.teaser: Russian attacks have damaged energy infrastructure and residential buildings in the Zhytomyr region.

items.title: Drohnenangriff in Tatarstan: Petrochemische Anlage brennt – Umspannwerk in Taganrog beschädigt
items.teaser: Nach einem Drohnenangriff brennt in Tatarstan eine petrochemische Anlage, in Taganrog wurde ein Umspannwerk beschädigt.

items.title: Russian drones strike energy infrastructure in Zhytomyr Oblast
items.teaser: Russian drones struck energy infrastructure and damaged four houses in Zhytomyr Oblast on the night of 14-15 November; no deaths or injuries have been reported.

items.title: Russian attacks leave 14 injured in Kharkiv region, damage businesses, warehouses, and homes
items.teaser: Fourteen people, including four children, were injured in Russian attacks in the Kharkiv region over the past day.

items.title: Petrochemical plant on fire in Tatarstan following drone attack, substation damaged in Taganrog – media
items.teaser: A fire broke out at the Nizhnekamskneftekhim industrial facility in Russia's Tatarstan region following a nighttime drone attack, while an electrical substation supplying power to Taganrog's industrial zone in the Rostov region was damaged.

items.title: Russians attack Chornomorsk: six injured, energy infrastructure damaged – photo
items.teaser: Six people were injured in a Russian attack on Chornomorsk in Odesa Oblast on 15 November. Energy and civilian infrastructure facilities were damaged.

items.teaser: Krieg gegen die Ukraine: Verletzte bei russischen Angriffen

items.title: Luftabwehr neutralisiert 106 von 132 feindlichen Drohnen
items.teaser: Die ukrainische Luftabwehr hat 106 von 132 Kampfdrohnen unschädlich gemacht, mit denen Russland seit Abend dem 14. November das Gebiet der Ukraine angegriffen hat.

items.title: War update: 171 combat engagements on front line over past day
items.teaser: On November 14, Ukraine's Defense Forces engaged Russian troops in 171 combat clashes along the front line.

items.title: General Staff: Russia has lost 1,622,860 troops in Ukraine since Feb. 24, 2022
items.teaser: The number includes 2,230 casualties that Russian forces suffered over the past day.

items.title: In Region Cherson 33 Ortschaften beschossen
items.teaser: Letzten Tag beschoss die russische Besatzungsarmee 33 Siedlungen in der Region Cherson. Bei Beschuss wurden Zivilisten weder getötet noch verletzt.

items.title: "Hochrangiger Terrorist": Israel tötet Hamas-Kommandeur im Gazastreifen
items.teaser: Trotz der formellen Waffenruhe fliegt Israel immer wieder Angriffe auf den Gazastreifen. Nun melden beide Seiten den Tod eines wichtigen Mitglieds der Essedin-al-Kassam-Brigaden.

items.title: Russian forces attack industrial facility in Kirovohrad region, causing fires
items.teaser: Russian forces attacked an industrial infrastructure facility in the Kirovohrad region, causing fires to break out.

items.title: Battlefield sees 171 combat clashes over past day, Russians drop 311 aerial bombs – Ukraine's General Staff
items.teaser: Ukraine's General Staff reports 171 combat clashes on the battlefield on 14 November; the Pokrovsk front suffered most attacks

items.title: Air defense neutralizes 106 of 132 Russian drones used to attack Ukraine
items.teaser: Air defense forces neutralized 106 drones used by the Russian military to attack Ukraine overnight on November 15.

items.title: Russo-Ukrainian war, day 1725: Russia demands NATO pullback and end to Britain’s nuclear shield over Europe
items.teaser: At the same time, Kyiv and Ottawa strike a new drone deal as Ukrainian makers show their tech in The Hague.

items.title: Russische Armee verliert 2.230 weitere Soldaten an einem Tag
items.teaser: Die Verluste der russischen Armee (Gefallene und Verwundete) in der Ukraine belaufen sich vom 24. Februar 2022 bis zum 15. November 2026 auf rund 1.622.860 Soldaten, darunter 2.230 weitere Verluste allein im Laufe des letzten Tages.

items.title: Region Kirowohrad: Industrieanlage nach russischem Angriff in Brand
items.teaser: Russische Truppen haben eine Industrieanlage in der Region Kirowohrad angegriffen, woraufhin ein Brand ausbrach.

items.title: Industrial facility catches fire in Kirovohrad Oblast following Russian attack
items.teaser: Russian forces attacked an industrial infrastructure facility in Kirovohrad Oblast on the night of 14-15 November. The strike sparked fires at two locations.

items.title: Private house catches fire following enemy attack in Dnipro district
items.teaser: A private house caught fire in Dnipro district following a drone attack.

items.title: Russians shell Dnipropetrovsk region more than 10 times since evening, damaging homes, transport infrastructure
items.teaser: Russian forces attacked four districts of the Dnipropetrovsk region more than 10 times since the evening, damaging residential buildings, a store, and transport infrastructure.

items.title: Eighteen people, including four children, injured in Russian attacks on Kharkiv and Donetsk oblasts
items.teaser: Russian strikes on Kharkiv and Donetsk oblasts injured 18 people on 14 November, among them four children aged four to 13.

items.title: Russian army loses another 2,230 soldiers in war against Ukraine over past day
items.teaser: The total estimated combat losses of Russian military personnel from February 24, 2022, to November 15, 2026, have reached approximately 1,622,860, including 2,230 troops lost by the enemy over the past 24 hours.

items.title: In Region Saporischschja 48 Ortschaften beschossen, 13 Zivilisten, darunter vier Kinder, verletzt
items.teaser: Am vergangenen Tag beschossen die russischen Besatzungstruppen 48 Ortschaften in der Region Saporischschja 877 Mal.

items.title: Ukrainian air defence downs 106 Russian drones overnight, hits recorded at 20 locations
items.teaser: Ukrainian air defence shot down or jammed 106 out of 132 Russian drones overnight, including 61 jet-powered, but hits were recorded at 20 locations.

items.title: Drone attack kills 1, injures 4 in Russia's Rostov Oblast, governor says
items.teaser: The attack damaged two electrical substations in Taganrog, including one supplying power to railway infrastructure. A fire broke out at a substation in the city's Shubin district, while power lines between the Taganrog-Passenger and Mikhailovka railway stations were left without electricity.

items.title: Israel strikes Hamas military wing, killing senior commander
items.teaser: Israel has carried out a strike against Hamas's military wing, killing a senior commander and injuring several other people.

items.title: Drone attack on Russia's Tatarstan causes fire at one of Europe's largest petrochemical plants – photo
items.teaser: A large-scale drone attack on Nizhnekamsk caused a major fire at Nizhnekamskneftekhim, one of Europe's largest petrochemical plants, eyewitness footage shows.

items.title: Russians strike Zaporizhzhia eight times, injuring five people, including an elderly woman
items.teaser: Russian forces carried out eight strikes on Zaporizhzhia, injuring five people, including an elderly woman. A fire broke out in an apartment building.

items.title: Program to relocate cultural workers from Russian regions to so-called LPR fails – Regional Administration
items.teaser: A program intended to relocate cultural workers from Russian regions to the so-called "Luhansk People's Republic" (LPR) has proven ineffective.

items.title: Russian attacks injure 32 people in Zaporizhzhia Oblast, including four children
items.teaser: Russian forces carried out 877 attacks on 48 settlements in Zaporizhzhia Oblast over the past day, injuring 32 people, including four children.

items.title: Prince Harry visits Lviv for first Superhumans War Trauma Conference
items.teaser: Prince Harry visited Lviv and took part in the first international Superhumans War Trauma Conference. The event took place on November 13–14, 2026, at the All-Ukrainian War Trauma Center.

items.title: YouTube blocks 16 Russian channels in Ukraine, including 'Masha and the Bear' versions
items.teaser: The latest restrictions are part of a broader effort to limit Russian influence on digital platforms. In October, Ukraine's National Security and Defense Council reported that another 39 channels spreading Russian propaganda had been blocked in Ukraine or removed from YouTube.

items.title: Russia loses 2,230 soldiers over past day
items.teaser: Ukraine's General Staff has updated data on Russian losses: Russia lost 2,230 soldiers killed and wounded over the past day.

items.title: Russia can not determine Europe's security architecture – Carney
items.teaser: Only European countries and NATO, not Russia, will decide what Europe's security architecture will look like.

items.title: Svitolina defeats Czech player Noskova to reach WTA tournament final
items.teaser: Elina Svitolina and "neutral" player Mirra Andreeva will face each other in the WTA tournament final.

items.title: US identifies cause of major outage that paralyzed air travel
items.teaser: A major outage in the US air traffic control system occurred during an upgrade of its communications network. Work to replace copper cable with fiber-optic cable caused a router malfunction, which overloaded part of the data transmission system connecting air traffic controllers and aircraft.

items.title: Fire reported at industrial facility in Russia's Tatarstan amid drone attack
items.teaser: Nizhnekamsk is a major center of Russia's petrochemical and oil-refining industries, home to the Nizhnekamskneftekhim complex and several large oil refineries, including TANECO and TAIF-NK.

items.title: Ukrainian embassy calls vandalism of Warsaw ghetto heroes monument act of Russia’s hybrid warfare
items.teaser: The Embassy of Ukraine in Poland has condemned an act of vandalism targeting the Ghetto Heroes Monument in Warsaw, describing the inscription “Slava UPA,” painted on the monument by unknown perpetrators, as an act of Russia’s hybrid warfare aimed at inciting hostility between Ukrainians and Poles.

items.title: Drones damage power substations in Russia's Taganrog – photos, videos
items.teaser: Drones struck two power substations in Taganrog, Rostov Oblast, including one serving the railway, suspending train services, the governor says.

items.title: Lubinets, Russian ombudswoman discuss mechanism for large-scale prisoner exchange
items.teaser: Ukraine’s Parliamentary Commissioner for Human Rights, Dmytro Lubinets, has discussed mechanisms for implementing a future prisoner exchange with Russian ombudswoman Yana Lantratova and received confirmation that it would involve at least 1,000 people.

items.title: Four more former Crimean prosecutors sentenced for treason
items.teaser: Four former prosecutors from Crimea – a former deputy prosecutor of Kerch, a senior prosecutor from the Bakhchysarai District Prosecutor's Office, and two former prosecutors from the Prosecutor's Office of the Autonomous Republic of Crimea – have been sentenced in absentia for high treason.

items.title: Three commercial ships struck by drones near Romania's Black Sea coast over two days
items.teaser: Speaking at the military port of Constanța on Nov. 14, Romanian Defense Minister Ștefan-Radu Oprea confirmed that Romanian authorities had been notified of the incident and that an investigation was underway.

items.title: Extortionists suspected of demanding $1M arrested in Mykolaiv region
items.teaser: The Security Service of Ukraine (SBU), jointly with the National Police, has exposed a criminal group whose members are suspected of demanding $1 million from a businessman over a fictitious debt.

items.title: Russians strike apartment blocks in Zaporizhzhia: six injured, including child – photos
items.teaser: Russian guided aerial bombs struck Zaporizhzhia on 14 November, damaging apartment blocks and dozens of cars, causing a fire and injuring six people, including a two-year-old child.

items.title: SBU exposes 109 criminal groups undermining stability in Ukraine this year
items.teaser: Since the beginning of the year, units of the Security Service of Ukraine's (SBU) Main Directorate D have exposed 109 criminal organizations and groups involved in undermining domestic stability and notified 3,920 individuals of suspicion.
